saints.name: Tendril Alien

saints.alt: Anglerfish Man, the Sixteenth Saint: a false lure in the trench, and teeth behind the kindness

saints.heading: ### The Book of the Mummy
saints.name: Mummy
saints.alt: Mummy, the Seventeenth Saint: one green eye and wraps that let go and will not be wound back

saints.heading: ### The Book of the Ram Oracle
saints.name: Ram Oracle
saints.alt: Ram Oracle, the Eighteenth Saint: curled horns and a third eye that opens late, the future already rotten

saints.heading: ### The Book of the Spore Man
saints.name: Spore Man
saints.alt: Spore Man, the Nineteenth Saint: a pulsing mushroom cap whose puff prefers a crowd

saints.heading: ### The Book of the Wax Saint
saints.name: Wax Saint
saints.alt: Wax Saint, the Twentieth Saint: a halo, a crown-flame, and a face that sags on purpose

scenes.alt: A dark machine room. A large CRT holds a grid of dead pixels, and one hot-pink cell has flipped and will not flip back. The Robot stands watch.
A dark chapel with chunky stained-glass blocks, pews, a pink aisle, and melting candles. The Wax Saint stands at the altar.
A bank vault with a circular door standing ajar, a pink interior, stacks of unmarked bars and discs, and the Frog Banker on a plinth.
A grimy back-room stall: empty shelves, a cracked case, a cheap lamp, and fat unmarked pennies scattered across the counter. No prices, no signs.
A long hall with a pink runner and five rising dais, each lit with more candles than the last, under tall windows that climb from dim purple to hot pink.
A wall of dead and half-alive CRT sets. Color bars and static, no typography. TV Head occupies the central screen.
A stone offering pit in a dark chamber. Chunky pink and amber flames consume a nameless frame. Smoke hangs in blocky puffs.
A deep trench of jagged rock and black water. A single lure glows. Anglerfish Man waits in the column of dark.
A night rooftop of blank-windowed towers, rusted vents, unlabeled bottles, and lumpy pink spore clouds. Spore Man stands on the roof.
A dying archive of server racks, most of the bays already dark. Pale wax drips down the middle rack. A cracked monitor holds one last pink pixel. The Wax Saint stands to the side.
